blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. However, conventional medical benchmarks assess reasoning over preselected evidence rather than the ability to seek it across clinical records and longitudinal imaging.
We propose CASE : a series of role-specific C linical A gents for S eeking E vidence, together with a tool-use harness and an agentic post-training framework for compact vision–language policy models.
We further introduce a longitudinal multimodal benchmark built on UK Biobank, comprising 50,401 clinical questions derived from real-world ICD-10-coded diagnoses of 4,739 participants. Each question links to a patient-specific environment containing clinical context and multi-sequence MRI from baseline and follow-up visits, where agents autonomously select which visits, organs, modalities, slices, and specialist tools to inspect and compare.
Supervised fine-tuning transfers evidence-seeking workflows from 14,734 frontier-model interaction trajectories, followed by agentic reinforcement learning on the learner’s own environment interactions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation and rubric-based LLM feedback refine evidence-to-conclusion reasoning without prescribing tool sequences.
Experiments show that CASE moves beyond question–answer imitation toward transferable investigation policies , strengthening evidence-grounded longitudinal reasoning. Under matched evaluation conditions, our Qwen3-VL-8B based agent achieves over 16% and 10% relative improvements in answer accuracy over GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Foundation models paired with tool-use harnesses show promise as clinical agents ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Yet longitudinal medical reasoning extends beyond medical knowledge: evidence is distributed across clinical records, imaging sequences, measurements, and follow-up visits, requiring agents to decide what to inspect before reaching a conclusion. Clinical reasoning therefore involves not only interpreting evidence, but also determining how to acquire it.
blocks.zh: 与工具使用带搭配的基建模型显示出作为临床制剂的前景(Wang等人,2026b); 张等, 2026a.). 然而,纵向医学推理超越了医学知识:证据在临床记录、成像序列、测量和后续访问中分布,要求代理人在得出结论之前决定检查什么。 因此,临床推理不仅涉及解释证据,而且还涉及确定如何获取证据。

blocks.en: This distinction matters for evaluation. Fixed-context medical QA assesses reasoning over preselected evidence, while interactive benchmarks introduce information gathering and sequential decision-making ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Chiu et al., 2025 ) . Longitudinal multimodal reasoning further requires comparing alternative paths through the same patient environment, motivating standardized tasks and evidence access while leaving acquisition to the policy. A central question is whether compact models can bootstrap clinical investigation from frontier-model trajectories and move beyond imitation through autonomous interaction. Demonstrations cover only teacher-chosen paths, whereas autonomous interaction exposes the learner to different combinations of evidence and requires it to reason over what it actually gathers.
blocks.zh: 这种区别对评价很重要。 固定文本医学质量保证评估对预选证据的推理,而交互式基准则引入信息收集和顺序决策(刘等人,2025年;Chiu等人,2025年)。 纵向多式联运推理还需要通过同样的耐心环境比较其他途径,推动标准化任务和证据获取,同时将获取权留给政策。 一个中心问题是,紧凑模型是否能够从前沿模型轨迹中引导临床调查,并通过自主互动超越模仿。 示威只涵盖教师选择的道路,而自主互动则使学习者面临不同组合的证据,要求学习者对其实际收集的内容进行推理.

blocks.en: We investigate this through CASE, where a compact vision–language policy acts as role-specific clinical agents within a shared tool-use harness. On our longitudinal multimodal benchmark built on UK Biobank ( Sudlow et al., 2015 ; Littlejohns et al., 2020 ) ( fig. 1 ), supervised fine-tuning (SFT) initializes the investigation policy from recorded frontier-model trajectories, after which agentic reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes the policy on its own environment interactions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation, with its self-teacher continually refreshed as the policy evolves, together with rubric-based large language model (LLM) feedback, progressively refines evidence-to-conclusion reasoning without prescribing tool sequences, allowing the agent to learn both what evidence to seek and how to reason from what it finds. Together, these designs support the following contributions: 1. Rethinking longitudinal medical reasoning as evidence seeking. By recasting longitudinal reasoning as an interactive evidence-seeking problem, we move beyond fixed-context evaluation and require agents to determine what patient evidence to inspect before reaching a conclusion. 2. Revisiting clinical agents as evidence-seeking investigators. CASE operationalizes this view through role-specific C linical A gents for S eeking E vidence, a patient-level tool-use harness, and a longitudinal multimodal benchmark , requiring agents to navigate heterogeneous evidence and invoke specialist tools when needed. 3. Exploring learning beyond teacher imitation. Starting from action-level teacher trajectories, we optimize the compact policy on its own environment interactions without direct answer supervision . Rubric-based LLM feedback and privileged self-distillation further strengthen evidence-to-conclusion synthesis, and the resulting agent surpasses frontier-model baselines under matched evaluation conditions; controlled ablations isolate the contribution of each component.
blocks.zh: 我们通过CASE来调查这个问题,其中紧凑的愿景-语言政策在共享的工具使用手段中起到特定作用的临床代理人的作用。 在我们基于英国生物银行的纵向多式联运基准(Sudlow等人,2015年;Littlejohns等人,2020年)(图1)上,监督微调(SFT)从记录的前沿-模型轨迹中初始化了调查政策,之后的代理强化学习(RL)在自身环境互动上优化了政策. 随着政策的发展,其自我教师不断更新,加上基于粗略的大型语言模型(LLM)反馈,在不规定工具序列的情况下,逐步完善了证据到结论推理,使代理人既可以学习寻找什么证据,又可以学习如何从发现的东西中推理。 这些设计共同支持以下贡献: 1. 重新思考纵向医学推理作为寻求的证据。 通过将纵向推理重塑为一个互动的求证问题,我们超越了固定的文字评价,要求代理人在得出结论之前确定哪些病人证据可以检查. 2. 恢复临床代理作为取证调查人员。 CASE通过针对特定角色的C linic A Gents for Seeking E evidence,一种病人一级的工具使用手段,以及纵向的多式联运基准,将这一观点付诸实施,要求代理人导航各种证据,并在必要时援引专家工具。 3.探索教师模仿以外的学习. 从行动层面的教师轨迹开始, 我们优化了紧凑的政策, 基于Rubric的LLM反馈和特权的自我消化进一步加强了证据到结论的合成,由此产生的剂在相应的评价条件下超过了前沿模型基线;受控调解隔离了每个成分的贡献.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Static question–answer (QA) benchmarks, however complex, give diminishing signal about real task completion, especially in data-scarce clinical agent settings that demand a realistic environment. Medical QA supplies text or images ( Jin et al., 2020 ; Zuo et al., 2025 ) ; agentic benchmarks add record operations, simulated encounters, and active information gathering ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Schmidgall et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Chiu et al., 2025 ) or widen specialty, longitudinal, and diagnostic-stage coverage ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Vasilev et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Ours grounds each question in recorded diagnoses and makes the agent gather the determining cross-visit magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), measurements, and reports (Appendix A.1 , table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 静态问答基准(QA)无论多么复杂,都给实际任务完成的信号越来越少,特别是在数据稀缺的临床代理环境需要现实环境的情况下。 医疗质量评估提供文字或图像(Jin等人,2020年;Zuo等人,2025年);代理基准增加记录操作、模拟接触和积极收集信息(Jiang等人,2025年;Schmidgall等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年;Chiu等人,2025年)或扩大专业、纵向和诊断阶段覆盖(Yan等人,2025年;Vasilev等人,2025年;Lu等人,2026年)。 我们根据记录的诊断对每个问题进行论证,使毒剂收集确定的交叉访问磁共振成像、测量和报告(附录A.1,表4)。

blocks.en: Medical agents adapt collaboration to task complexity ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , coordinate tools and verification ( Fallahpour et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , or learn from memory and feedback ( Almansoori et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , though MedAgentBoard finds such gains task-dependent ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) ; parameter learning spans supervised tool invocation ( Li et al., 2024 ) to RL ( Jiang et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026a ; Fan et al., 2026 ) . CASE instead trains one shared compact policy that learns acquisition and synthesis jointly rather than orchestrating fixed specialists (Appendix A.2 , tables 5 and 6 ).
blocks.zh: 医疗人员根据任务的复杂性(Kim等人,2024年)调整协作,协调工具和核查(Fallahpour等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b;Zhang等人,2026年a),或从记忆和反馈中学习(Almansoori等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年b),尽管MedAgentBoard发现这种成果依赖于任务(Zhu等人,2025年);参数学习跨度监督工具引用(Li等人,2024年b);RL(Jiang等人,2026年b; Jiang等人,2026a;Fan等人,2026). CASE转而执行一种共同的契约政策,即共同学习获取和综合,而不是安排固定专家(附录A.2,表5和表6)。

blocks.en: Prior distillation transfers teacher or privileged signals via guidance on student-generated sequences ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , privileged self-teachers ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ) , selective reasoning supervision under Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Tan and Hong, 2026 ) , or turn-, token-, and step-level feedback ( Tian et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . CASE instead turns the divergence between ordinary and answer-privileged views of the same frozen policy into a detached trajectory-level reward penalty rather than a differentiable distillation loss; entering the return before group normalization, it reorders whole trajectories by synthesis quality, whereas OCSD, SSPO, PBSD, and ADRS adjust token-, step-, or turn-level weights without reordering whole trajectories, so synthesis feedback shapes acquisition without tool-specific credit assignment or an auxiliary loss (Appendix D , table 11 ).
blocks.zh: 事先蒸馏通过指导学生生成的序列转移教师或特权信号(Agarwal等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年c;Liu等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年),特权自导师(赵等人,2026年;Hübotter等人,2026年),在集团相对政策优化(GRPO)下进行选择性推理监督(Shao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年a;Tan和Hong,2026年),或转动,符号,和级反馈(Tian等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026b;杨等人,2026年;吴等人,2026年). CASE将同一被冻结政策的普通观点和回答偏好观点之间的分歧转变为脱节的轨迹级奖励处罚,而不是不同的蒸馏损失;在组群正常化前进入回报,它通过合成质量重新排列整个轨迹,而OSD、SSPO、PBSD和ADRS则在不重新排列整个轨迹的情况下调整令牌、步骤或转弯级权重,因此合成反馈形成没有特定工具信用分配或辅助损失的获取(附录D,表11)。

blocks.en: 4 A Longitudinal Evidence-Seeking Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 纵向取证基准

blocks.en: CASE makes evidence acquisition itself the task . Each patient is asked several questions, each a multiple-choice question (MCQ), together spanning several clinical domains; given only the narrative and one such question, the agent interleaves tool calls with reasoning to decide which longitudinal, multi-sequence studies to inspect, with each returned observation conditioning the next decision and the final answer. Accuracy thus reflects what the agent chooses to gather from a scarce, heterogeneous imaging environment rather than evidence fixed in advance. Figure 1 overviews the imaging, the questions derived from International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision (ICD-10) codes, and the recorded trajectories.
blocks.zh: CASE将取证本身作为任务。 每个病人被问到几个问题,每个问题是一个多选择问题(MCQ),共同涉及几个临床领域;鉴于只有叙述和一个这样的问题,代理人间隙工具用推理调用,决定检查的纵向,多序列研究,每个返回的观察条件为下一个决定和最后答案. 因此,准确性反映了制剂选择从稀缺、多样的成像环境中收集的东西,而不是预先确定的证据。 图1概括了成像,国际疾病分类衍生的问题,第十修订版(ICD-10)编码,以及记录的轨迹.

blocks.en: Built on UK Biobank ( Sudlow et al., 2015 ) , CASE contains 50,401 questions from 4,739 participants, including 4,850 held-out questions from 455. Questions derive from doctor-diagnosed conditions and ICD-10 records, pair each recorded target with cohort-derived distractors that exclude the participant’s own diagnoses, and span seven clinical families and ten task–format strata over binary, single-select, and multi-select items (panel 2 of fig. 1 ); Appendix A details distractor sampling, task expansion, and label correction.
blocks.zh: CASE建于UK Biobank上(Sudlow等人,2015年),包含来自4,739位参与者的50,401个问题,包括来自455的4,850个搁置问题. 问题来自医生诊断的病症和ICD-10记录,将每个记录的目标与排除参与者自身诊断的组群分心器配对,在二进制、单选式和多选式项目(图2)上横跨7个临床家庭和10个任务格式层。 1),附录. 详细分辨器采样,任务扩展,以及标签校正.

blocks.en: Each participant’s environment pairs baseline and follow-up MRI of the same subject from the UK Biobank imaging visits ( Littlejohns et al., 2020 ; UK Biobank, ) , a median of 2.26 years apart, so within-subject interval comparison is available for every question; panel 4 of fig. 1 adds the resulting workload of just over ten questions per participant and roughly eight images per resolved trajectory. The imaging is scarce and heterogeneous, covering five organ regions (heart, brain, pancreas, liver, and whole body) across seven sub-modalities, with most participants contributing two or three organ groups (panels 3 and 5). Tools expose MRI views, Vista3D-derived measurements and overlays ( He et al., 2025 ) , and MedGemma-27B reports ( Sellergren et al., 2025 ) ; the agent chooses which tool, organ, sequence, visit, and frame to retrieve and whether to compare across visits, so the evidence path is policy-controlled, while diagnosis records supply the answer labels (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) to record role-conditioned trajectories across the three agents in LangGraph environments ( LangChain Team, 2024 ) , withholding reference answers until first-pass completion; each trajectory interleaves tool calls with roughly eight to ten paired-visit images, yielding 147,434 recordings, of which the screening rule of eq. 3 retains approximately 140,000 demonstrations for initialization from training participants (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用Quen3.8-Max(Quen Team, 2026c)记录LangGraph环境中三个特工(LangChain Team, 2024 )的角色条件轨迹,在第一通道完成前不提供参考答案;每个轨迹间叶工具调用大约8到10对访问图像,产生147,434个录音,其中eq. 3的筛选规则保留了约140,000个演示从培训参与者开始初始化(附录C ).

blocks.en: Figure 2 : CASE training and execution. (1) Two-stage training: RSFT distills screened teacher trajectories into Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, then agentic RL refines the policy on its own trajectories via outcome reward, OPSD, and RLAIF from an external non-ancestor judge. (2) One shared policy instantiates three evidence-seeking workflows through role prompts and tool registries. (3) A common contract alternates evidence decisions and tool observations until the P1–P5 synthesis. Privileged information scores completed training trajectories only and never determines the tool sequence.

blocks.en: Panel 1 of fig. 2 outlines our two-stage pipeline. We first record role-conditioned teacher trajectories and distill a quality-filtered subset into the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct base ( Bai et al., 2025 ) by rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RSFT), which rapidly initializes how to act as an agent (calling tools, alternating evidence decisions with observations, and following the synthesis contract). Agentic RL then optimizes the policy on its own trajectories, combining outcome reward, privileged on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of the synthesis step, and rubric feedback from an external non-ancestor judge (Kimi K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026a ) ) that scores the logical core of each chain of thought, so the policy is rewarded for an answer justified by sound Phase-4 reasoning rather than correctness alone; both stages train the full vision–language model end to end, including the visual pathway. We initialize from the Instruct checkpoint rather than a thinking variant to avoid starting from a model already specialized for explicit chain-of-thought output; this does not imply that the Instruct checkpoint received no vendor-side reinforcement learning ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Efficiency and kernel-stability considerations appear in Appendix C . RSFT only imitates demonstrations and thus teaches the form of acting, whereas the genuine gains in reasoning and accuracy come from agentic RL , in which the base model explores the harness on its own and can surpass its teacher. Because the reference answer is fixed by a participant’s evidence and train/test participants are disjoint, the answer is never a direct function of the question , so the policy must seek the determining evidence rather than memorize question–answer pairs.

blocks.en: 5.4 On-policy privileged self-distillation for synthesis
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 政策上的自我消化

blocks.en: In mid-to-late RL the policy stalls, prolonging Phase 4 by restating findings and repeating discourse connectives instead of committing to a conclusion; this repetitive mode coincides with a sudden reward drop and arises because a compact policy learns the surface form of an explanation before it reliably resolves the answer. We therefore apply privileged on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), whose training-only privileged information provides an answer-informed reference for synthesis on the policy’s own evidence history while leaving tool decisions autonomous. Because the privileged view conditions on a resolved answer, at a fixed synthesis prefix it shifts probability mass away from further restatement and toward advancing or terminating, so aligning the ordinary view with it discourages repetitive continuations without dictating their content. Appendix I.4 gives a formal event bound and section 6 tests the effect through an 8-gram repetition diagnostic ( eq. 15 ) and the late-training completion behavior of the ablation variants in fig. 3 ; top-128 truncation is justified by measured next-token coverage ( fig. 9 ) and the two-forward scoring alignment is tabulated in table 18 .
blocks.zh: 在中期到晚期的RL中,政策停顿,通过重复调查结果和重复言论来延长第四阶段的关联性,而不是承诺作出结论;这种重复模式与突然的奖励下降同时出现,因为一项紧凑的政策在可靠地解决答案之前就学会了解释的表面形式。 因此,我们运用特权政策自我消化(OPSD ) , 其只有培训的特权信息为综合政策本身的证据历史提供了一个有答案的参考,同时让工具决策自主。 由于一个解答上的特权观点条件,在一个固定的合成前缀中,它将概率质量从进一步重述转向推进或终止,因此将普通观点与它相配合,不鼓励重复性继续,而不描述其内容。 附录一.4给出了正式事件绑定,第6节通过8克的重复诊断(eq. 15)测试效果,并测试了在图解变体中的延迟训练完成行为. 3;上-128截图通过测量的邻接覆盖度(图9)证明合理,双向积分对齐表18.

blocks.en: Our goal is not merely a correct answer but one reached through a sound Phase-4 key insight. blocks.en: Figure 3 compares RSFT alone with GRPO using neither addition, rubric feedback alone, OPSD alone, or both; all RL variants retain correctness and format rewards and the same reference-policy regularizer, and rubric feedback adds the continuous insight score and top-2 linkage. Evaluation instead scores each insight with a fixed external judge without top-2 selection, reporting three-role means of accuracy and insight quality on questions scorable for every variant, with judge controls, coverage, and role-specific results in Appendix F and table 15 . The training traces make the complementarity explicit ( fig. 3 ; full epoch in fig. 7 ), where without OPSD, GRPO+RLAIF optimizes the rubric with no brake on discourse and restates earlier findings until the correctness reward collapses over the final third of the epoch (highlighted band), whereas CASE-8B and GRPO+OPSD avoid this degeneration and CASE-8B additionally converts the rubric signal into higher endpoint accuracy. Remarkably, even though the rubric is a black-box signal from an external judge, it still drives a steady rise in judged insight quality throughout training, consistently under three different judge models ( fig. 8 ; Appendix F ).

blocks.en: To confirm the policy uses acquired evidence rather than priors, table 16 varies what the agent may obtain (question-only, clinical-context-only, fixed-evidence) and removes each source (MRI, follow-up, reports) in turn (denominators in Appendix F ). Accuracy drops whenever acquisition is withheld or a source removed, separating evidence-seeking from answer priors and from format or length artifacts; these ablate the evidence channel , not the learning components. blocks.en: 6.4 Qualitative analysis
blocks.zh: 6.4 定性分析

blocks.en: Appendix B.1 renders one complete Consultant rollout showing the behaviour the method targets. The agent recalls a written skill, cross-checks segmentation, cross-visit comparison, and draft reports, and, crucially, doubts an over-calling draft impression, requesting the missing arterial and washout evidence before rejecting it. The Phase-4 insight and final answer agree, tool calls stay within budget, and a post-answer review writes the conclusion back to skill memory, closing the acquisition–synthesis–memory loop of section 5 ; the trajectory thus makes the aggregate gains legible as doubt resolved against acquired evidence.
blocks.zh: 附录B.1使一个完整的顾问推开,显示方法目标的行为。 代理人回顾一种书面技能、交叉检查、交叉访问比较和报告草案,并关键地怀疑过度呼唤的草稿印象,要求在拒绝之前先要求缺失的动脉和冲洗证据。 第四阶段的洞察力和最后的答案一致,工具呼吁不超出预算,而后答的回顾将结论写回技能记忆,结束第5节的获取-合成-记忆循环;因此,轨迹使得汇总收益可以辨别,因为根据获得的证据解决了疑问。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7. 结论和限制

blocks.en: CASE establishes a general framework for both evaluating and learning clinical investigation, making evidence acquisition measurable while keeping investigation policy-driven and evidence synthesis trainable. Although real clinical practice spans broader toolsets and specialty-specific diagnostic pathways, the same evaluation and training paradigm can be instantiated by specifying the available evidence, tools, and decision contract, providing a principled route from fixed-context assessment and workflow engineering toward learnable clinical investigation. Several limitations remain. Clinical labels may be unobservable from the available images, and generated evidence and judges remain fallible; establishing utility beyond this cohort, including generalization and efficiency, remains future work.
blocks.zh: CASE为评价和学习临床调查建立了一个总框架,使证据获取可以衡量,同时保持调查政策驱动和证据综合可以训练。 虽然真实的临床实践跨越了更广泛的工具以及特殊诊断路径,但同样的评价和培训范式可以通过具体说明现有证据、工具和决定合同,提供从固定内容评估和工作流程工程到可学习的临床调查的原则路线,来即时化。 仍然存在若干限制。 临床标签可能无法从现有图像中观察到,生成的证据和法官仍然不可信;在这类人之外建立效用,包括一般化和效率,仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: The distinction of interest is whether patient evidence is supplied as context or acquired through actions, and which aspects of the resulting interaction are evaluated. These are overlapping design choices, not a progression from non-agentic to uniformly superior benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 兴趣的区别在于病人的证据是作为上下文提供的还是通过行动获得的,以及由此产生的相互作用的哪些方面得到评价. 这些是相互重叠的设计选择,而不是从非代理性基准发展到统一的优越基准。

blocks.en: Jin et al. (2020) and Pal et al. (2022) organize medical examination questions in MedQA and MedMCQA; the former also study document retrieval, so medical QA should not be equated with universally fixed knowledge access. Jin et al. (2019) condition PubMedQA answers on biomedical abstracts. Lau et al. (2018) , Liu et al. (2021) , and Butsanets et al. (2026) emphasize image-conditioned questions in VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and RadImageNet-VQA, while Zuo et al. (2025) include challenging clinical text and multimodal questions in MedXpertQA. Difficulty and clinical content alone do not specify whether the model must select observations from a patient-indexed environment.
blocks.zh: Jin等人(2020年)和Pal等人著. (2022)在MedQA和MedMCQA中组织体检问题;前者也研究文件检索,因此医疗QA不应等同于普遍固定的知识获取. 龚等. (2019)条件 PubMedQA 解答生物医学摘要. Lau et al. (2018), Liu et al. (2021),以及 Butsanets et al. (2026)在VQA-RAD,SLAKE,以及RadImageNet-VQA中强调图像条件问题,而Zuo等人(2025)则在MedXpertQA中包含了挑战性临床文本和多式联运问题. 单是困难和临床内容并不能说明模型是否必须从患者索引环境中选择观测结果。

blocks.en: Jiang et al. (2025) provide patient-specific FHIR tasks in MedAgentBench, and Schmidgall et al. (2024) support information gathering through AgentClinic encounters. Qiu et al. (2025) evaluate clinical reasoning in MedR-Bench. Vasilev et al. (2025) combine longitudinal oncology decisions with multimodal tools in MTBBench, while Lu et al. (2026) study information acquisition and decisions across inpatient stages in ClinEnv. These are substantive precedents for autonomous medical interaction. CASE studies a complementary setting: fixed clinical-label questions paired with follow-up imaging evidence whose measurements, views, and generated reports are separately accessible. Recording an evidence path enables its analysis; neither logging nor answer correctness establishes that the path contains a valid medical justification.
blocks.zh: Jiang等人(2025年)在MedAgent Bench提供针对患者的FHIR任务,Schmidgall等人(2024年)通过AgentClinic相遇支持信息采集. 邱等编. (2025)在MedR-Bench中评价临床推理. Vasilev等人(2025年)在MTB Bench中将纵向肿瘤学决定与多式联运工具相结合,而Lu等人则在MTB Bench中合并. (2026)在ClinEnv研究跨住院阶段的信息获取和决定. 这些是自主医疗互动的实质性先例。 CASE研究一个补充环境:固定的临床标签问题与后续成像证据结合,其测量、观察和生成的报告可以单独获取。 记录证据路径有助于分析;记录或回答正确均不能证明路径含有有效的医学理由。

blocks.en: Bourigault et al. (2025) introduce UKBOB for large-scale MRI segmentation supervision and evaluation of segmentation generalization. CASE contributes a different task structure: participant cohort, longitudinal question instances, taxonomy, reference labels, partitions, evaluation rules, and an executable evidence interface. A data resource can also support benchmarks; the distinction is the task and evaluation protocol, not whether the underlying participant data can be redistributed. Baseline configurations and required measurements are specified in Appendix F ; controlled baseline results remain to be supplied.
blocks.zh: Bourigault等人(2025年)引入了UKBOB,用于大规模分解磁共振分解的监督和评估分解一般化. CASE提供了不同的任务结构:参与者群、纵向问题实例、分类学、参考标签、分区、评价规则以及可执行的证据接口。 数据资源也可以支持基准;区别在于任务和评价协议,而不是基本的参与者数据是否可以重新分配。 附录F规定了基准配置和所需测量;控制下的基准结果仍有待提供。

blocks.en: A.2 Medical agents and forms of adaptation
blocks.zh: A.2 医疗人员和适应形式

blocks.en: An agent can change its decisions through new observations, retrieved experience, or parameter updates. These mechanisms should not be conflated. In particular, inference-time orchestration can support autonomous actions and recovery without optimizing the underlying model, while supervised tool training already learns a policy even without RL. Tables 5 and 6 describe the adaptation mechanisms reported in the cited papers, not a binary judgment of whether a system is a genuine agent. Training an external segmentation model is also distinct from training the agent that chooses to invoke it.
blocks.zh: 一个代理可以通过新的观察,检索经验,或参数更新来改变其决定. 这些机制不应混为一谈。 特别是,推论时间安排可以支持自主行动和恢复,而不优化基本模式,而监督工具培训即使没有RL,也已经学会了政策。 表5和表6说明了所引用文件中报告的适应机制,而不是对某一系统是否为真正代理人的二进制判断。 培训外部分解模式也不同于培训选择援引该模式的代理人。

blocks.en: Table 5: Workflow and context-based adaptation in medical agents. These mechanisms can change actions within or across cases without an agent-policy gradient update. The classification concerns the described agent adaptation, not the training history of every component.
blocks.zh: 表5:医疗剂的工作流量和基于具体情况的适应。 这些机制可以在不更新代理政策梯度的情况下改变案件内部或案件之间的行动。 分类涉及所述代理人适应,而不是每个组成部分的培训历史。

blocks.zh: 表6:学习的医疗工具政策。 比较查明了监督和任务结构的差异,而不是在共同基准上的比较业绩的证据。

blocks.en: Liu et al. (2025) organize 12,163 MedChain cases into five sequential stages, including medical-image examination; MedChain is neither a static-QA benchmark nor a text-only predecessor. Chiu et al. (2025) begin VivaBench with limited case information and let the candidate request history, examinations, and investigations before diagnosis. Yan et al. (2025) combine a real-case benchmark spanning 24 departments and 150 diseases with ClinicalAgent; its imaging stage uses textual radiology reports. Zhu et al. (2025) compare collaboration with single-model and conventional approaches across medical QA and EHR prediction, finding that collaboration does not consistently dominate. These results motivate evaluating each system component rather than treating additional agents as intrinsically beneficial.
blocks.zh: 刘等. (2025年)组织 12,163 MedChain病例分为五个相继阶段,包括医疗图像检查; MedChain既不是一个静态-QA基准,也不是仅文本的前身.  Chi等. (2025年)开始Viva Bench只有有限的案例信息,让候选人在诊断前要求历史,检查和调查. 颜等. (2025年)将涵盖24个省和150种疾病的实案基准与临床医生相结合;其成像阶段使用文字放射学报告。  Zhu等. (2025)将协作与医学质量保证和EHR预测的单一模式和常规方法进行比较,发现协作并非始终占主导地位。 这些结果促使人们评价每个系统组成部分,而不是将其他因素视为内在的好处。

blocks.en: Clinical evidence gathering, multimodal grounding, compact tool-using models, and medical agentic RL all have precedents. MedVR also conditions an auxiliary tool reward on answer correctness, so outcome-linked feedback alone is not a distinguishing claim. The present design evaluates the learner’s post-retrieval synthesis under ordinary and training-only privileged contexts on the same realized evidence history. Its detached insight penalty enters the joint correctness and rubric reward before group normalization, rather than prescribing a retrieved case, a teacher tool sequence, or a consensus image region. This specifies a testable design difference, not a demonstrated advantage. Matched ablations are required to establish its value beyond existing RL and distillation mechanisms. Cross-system comparisons additionally require compatible observation interfaces and explicit memory-freezing rules; a shared backbone alone does not equalize evidence access.
blocks.zh: 临床证据收集、多式联运地面、紧凑的工具使用模型和医疗剂RL都有先例。 MeDVR也以回答正确性作为辅助工具奖励的条件,因此仅与结果相关的反馈就不是一个区分的主张. 目前的设计在普通和只受过培训的特权背景下,根据同样的实际证据历史,评价学习者的检索后综合。 其脱节的洞察惩罚在群体正常化前进入共同的正确性和标点奖励,而不是规定一个被检索的案件,一个教师工具序列,或者一个协商一致的图像区域. 这具体说明了可测试的设计差异,而不是已经证明的优势。 为了确定它的价值,需要经过匹配的加工,以超越现有的制冷和蒸馏机制。 跨系统比较还需要兼容的观测接口和明确的内存冻结规则;单靠一个共享的主干线并不能使证据获取均等.

blocks.en: Yao et al. (2023) interleave reasoning with environment actions in ReAct, Schick et al. (2023) study learned API use in Toolformer, Li et al. (2023) adapt multimodal instruction following to biomedicine in LLaVA-Med, and Gu et al. (2024) study reverse-KL distillation into compact language models in MiniLLM. These foundations motivate the learning components without making their combination in an agent sufficient evidence of novelty.
blocks.zh: 姚等编. (2023年)ReAct,Schick等人(2023年)的研究中学习了在Tolformer,Li等人(2023年)中应用API的方法,根据LLaVA-Med和Gu等人的生物医学调整了多式联运规范。 (2024)在MiniLLM中研究反向-KL蒸馏成紧凑语言模型. 这些基础激发了学习部分的动力,而没有将它们组合成一种充分的新颖性证据。

blocks.en: During recording, Anatomist and Radiologist bind their respective three-tool registries, while Consultant binds all ten tools. The deployed mixed-role RL job initializes the ten-tool union registry for every rollout and relies on each role prompt to specify the intended workflow. Consultant directly requests the underlying evidence sources; it does not launch independently trained specialist agents or receive an ensemble vote. Skill retrieval is an auxiliary memory mechanism, rather than a fourth patient-imaging modality.

blocks.en: Evidence preparation is completed before RL so that policy rollouts do not wait for segmentation or report-generation inference. First, Vista3D produces whole-body Dixon segmentation masks and MedGemma generates report objects from MRI renderings, as detailed in Appendix A . Second, cache construction derives organ volumes from the masks using eq. 8 , computes station-level quantities and absolute or relative changes across visits, and stores the resulting text with rendered overlays. The imaging cache stores acquisition metadata, MRI views, and paired-visit comparisons. Report text has its ICD-10 diagnostic codes removed before caching so it cannot leak the reference answer, and reports are indexed with their source montages for retrieval. This separates the GPU requirements of evidence-generating models from policy training and amortizes preparation over repeated patient interactions.
blocks.zh: 证据编制工作在报告编写之前完成,以便政策推出不会等待分门别类或报告生成推论。 首先,Vista3D生产全身的Dixon分区口罩,MedGemma从核磁共振渲染中生成报告对象,详见附录A. 第二,缓存构造利用eq.8计算站台级数量和访问时的绝对或相对变化,并从口罩中获取器官体积,并将由此产生的文字与所渲染的上下文储存在一起。 成像缓存存储获取元数据,核磁共振视图,以及配对访问比较. 报告文本在缓存前删除了它的ICD-10诊断代码,因此它不能泄露参考答案,报告会用其源代码索引以进行检索。 这将生成证据模型的GPU要求与政策培训区分开来,并分期摊还了重复的患者互动准备.

blocks.en: The recording and evaluation specialists read the participant’s MRI and segmentation sources and render each requested observation (volume, comparison, view, or frame) on demand. For instance, cardiac short-axis, frame 14 or liver, baseline versus follow-up resolves against the stored sources into a rendered view, an organ volume, or a longitudinal comparison. During RL, mock tools resolve each policy-generated request against precomputed observations rather than rerunning source-model inference, keyed by the participant, tool, and requested arguments; missing entries return visible error or unavailable-data observations. Vista3D and imaging adapters read cached text and rendered images; the report adapter locates pre-generated JSON through a manifest and formats it on request. Loading, resizing, and assembling images remain online operations. These adapters serve observations for the policy’s current requests; they do not supply the next teacher action. SFT subsequently consumes recorded conversations, whereas RL acquires observations through fresh policy-generated calls.
blocks.zh: 记录和评价专家阅读了参与者的磁共振和分解来源,并按要求提出每一项意见(数量、比较、视图或框架)。 例如,心脏短轴、框架14或肝脏、基线与后续对存储源的处理方法,即成向视图、器官体积或纵向比较。 在 RL 期间, 模拟工具对照预算的观测结果解决了每个由政策生成的请求, 而不是重运行由参与者键入的源模型推论, 工具和请求的参数; 缺失的条目返回可见错误或无法获取的数据观测结果 。 Vista3D和成像适配器读取缓存文本并渲染图像;报告适配器通过一个表单定位预生成的JSON,并根据请求格式化. 装入、重新调整大小和组装图像仍然是在线操作。 这些适配器为目前政策的要求提供观察服务;它们不提供下一次教师行动。 SFT随后会消耗录制的对话,而RL则通过新的政策生成的电话获取观察.

blocks.en: The action semantics are fixed by the tool schemas: the policy selects the tool, the organ (resolved to a segmentation label through the Vista3D organ-index map), the sequence and sub-modality, the visit, and the frame or slice to view or compare. In recording and evaluation, the specialists render each requested view, overlay, or comparison from the participant’s source volumes on demand, so distinct frame requests yield distinct observations; the RL replay adapter serves the same observations from precomputed stores keyed by the request, for efficiency. Consultant’s image and volume tools follow the same request semantics in the LangGraph runtime. Tool schemas, field formatting, and missing-entry behavior are part of the environment specification.

blocks.en: Skill memory is frozen during RL but run-scoped at evaluation. In the RL replay adapter ( LIVE_SKILL=0 ), recall_skills deterministically queries a static store and write_skill acknowledges requests without persistence, keeping the environment fixed ( section 5.3 ). Held-out evaluation instead sets LIVE_SKILL=1 : within one run write_skill appends to the in-memory store, so later questions can recall skills written earlier in the same run, but the store is never written back to disk (live within a run, frozen across runs), and its base contents exclude test participants.
blocks.zh: 技能内存在RL时被冷冻,但在评价时运行扫描. 在RL重播适配器(LIVE_SKILL=0)中,召回_技能确定性地询问一个静态商店,write_skill不持久地确认请求,保持环境固定(第5.3节). Hold-out评价则设置了LIVE_SKILL=1:在一个运行的write_skill attacks到内存商店,因此后来的提问可以召回同一运行中较早时编写的技能,但该商店从未被写回磁盘(运行内存,跨运行间结冰),其基本内容排除了测试参与者.

blocks.en: The vista3d tools accept free-text organ names and resolve them in two fixed steps: a hardcoded index-to-label map over 32 organs (e.g. 1=liver, 115=heart, 151=left_ventricle) with its generated inverse, and an alias table that folds colloquial variants (hepatic, spine, kidneys, gall bladder) into canonical names after lowercasing and whitespace normalization. Lookup tries the alias table, then the canonical map; an unresolvable name returns a visible “unknown organ” observation rather than raising, so the policy can retry with another name. Because a segmentation is a per-voxel integer label array, the organ mask is the equality test against the resolved index: voxel count times per-voxel volume gives the organ volume in millilitres, per-station counts locate the dominant slice, and the same equality mask renders the overlay. The policy never sees these format details; the complete candidate organ list for a participant (up to 20, enumerated from that participant’s segmentation) is supplied in the prompt at recording and evaluation. In RL the mock tool reuses the identical name-translation step and then reads a precomputed cache keyed by participant, tool, and canonical name, so recording, evaluation, and training agree on resolution behavior.
blocks.zh: 透视3d工具接受自由文字器官名称并分两个固定步骤解决:硬编码索引至标签图,覆盖32个器官(如1=liver,115=heart,151=left_ventricle),其生成的反面,以及一个别名表,将拼音变体(肝,脊,肾,胆膀胱)折叠为下架和白空间正常化后冠名. Lookup 尝试了别名表,然后是cononical map;一个无法解答的名称返回一个可见的"未知的器官"观察,而不是提高,因此政策可以用另一个名称重试. 因为分化是每伏xel整数标签阵列,所以器官面具是对照解析指数进行平等测试:每个伏xel体积的voxel计数次数使器官体积以毫升计数,每站计数会定位占优势的切片,同样的平等面具会做出覆盖. 政策从未看到这些格式的细节;在记录和评价时,立即提供一名参加者的完整的候选机构名单(最多20份,从该参加者的分类中列出)。 在 RL 中,模拟工具重复使用相同的名称-翻译步骤,然后读取一个由参与者,工具,和犬类名称键入的预计算缓存,所以记录,评价,和训练都同意解析行为.

blocks.en: In LangGraph recording, assistant tool requests produce text tool messages followed by an image-bearing user message encoded as data URIs. Saved conversations retain image references for subsequent loading. In RL, the patched tool loop constructs a tool message with one placeholder for each returned image, followed by its text. The processor receives images in the same order and produces pixel values and grid descriptors. The Qwen3-VL forward encodes these pixels and uses masked scatter to replace the corresponding placeholder embeddings; intermediate visual features also enter the decoder through its DeepStack pathway ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Newly rendered observation positions are appended with zero action mask, while the cumulative image list is retained for later multimodal forwards. The next assistant turn therefore conditions on accumulated text and visual evidence. Only assistant-generated positions contribute to the policy-gradient action likelihood.
blocks.zh: 在LangGraph录制中,助理工具请求生成文本工具消息,然后生成一个包含图像的用户消息,编码为数据URI. 保存的对话保留图像引用供后续加载 。 在 RL 中,补丁工具循环构造一个工具消息,每个返回的图像有一个占位符,然后是它的文本. 处理器以相同的顺序接收图像,并产生像素值和网格描述符. Quen3-VL前置编码这些像素,并使用遮罩散射来取代相应的占位符嵌入;中间视觉特征也通过其DeepStack路径(Bai等人,2025年)进入解码器. . 新制作的观测姿势附有零动作罩,而累积图像清单则保留用于以后的多式联运。 因此,下一位助理就累积的文字和视觉证据提出条件。 只有助理产生的职位才有可能导致政策逐步采取行动的可能性。

blocks.en: For a processed image grid ( t , h , w ) (t,h,w) with spatial merge factor m m , the number of visual embedding positions is N vis = t ​ h ​ w / m 2 N_{\mathrm{vis}}=thw/m^{2} . A 512-pixel square image with 16-pixel patches and m = 2 m=2 gives 256 positions. Actual counts depend on processor geometry; the placeholder token is a position marker, not a discrete encoding of image content. The evidence cache stores observations, not learned visual embeddings: vision-encoder and merger features are recomputed in model forwards from the retained pixel inputs. Both OPSD conditions receive the same images. During SFT and actor optimization, assistant-token losses propagate through the visual features to update the visual modules; OPSD scoring supplies the detached reward described in sections 5.4 and 5.5 .
blocks.zh: 对于一个经过处理的图像网格(t, h, w) (t, h, w) 具有空间合并因子 m m 的图像网格,视觉嵌入位置数为 N 相对于 t h w / m 2 N_{\ mathrm{vis}}=thw/ m^{2}. 带有16像素补丁的512像素方形图像,m=2米=2给出256个位置. 实际计数取决于处理器几何;占位符是位置标记,而不是图像内容的离散编码. 证据缓存存储了观察,而不是学习到的视觉嵌入:视觉编码器和兼并特性从保留像素输入的模型前方重编. 两个OPSD条件都接收到相同的图像. 在SFT和演员优化期间,助理脚本损失通过视觉特性传播,以更新视觉模块;OPSD评分提供第5.4节和第5.5节描述的离散奖励.

blocks.en: The supplied Vista3D and MedPanel adapters load at most six cached images, stack them vertically, and resize the composite to one 512 × 512 512\times 512 PIL image. Their per-call output is thus zero or one image, potentially containing multiple views. The report adapter selects at most two montage/overview images and preserves aspect ratio while limiting the longest edge to 512. Its current return values are base64 strings rather than PIL objects; the complete installed schema and processor are needed to establish successful decoding. This distinction matters when comparing rollout and evaluation visual exposure.
blocks.zh: 所提供的Vista3D和MedPanel适配器最多负载6个缓存图像,垂直堆放,并将复合体大小调整为1个512×512 512\times 512 PIL图像. 因此,它们的按呼输出为零或一幅图像,可能包含多种视图。 报告适配器最多选择两个蒙太奇/综观图像,并保留宽比,同时将最长的边缘限制在512. 它目前的返回值是基数64字符串,而不是PIL对象;需要完整的安装的chema和处理器来建立成功的解码. 在比较推出和评价视觉曝光时,这种区分很重要。

blocks.en: The Consultant LangGraph tool node enforces a 12-call budget on the first pass. The specialist prompts request at most four calls for Radiologist and one to three for Anatomist, but the supplied specialist nodes do not implement the same cumulative hard cap. The canonical RL wrapper allows ten assistant turns and a 6,144-token continuation; its local tool-loop patch additionally applies a per-turn parallel-call limit and checks continuation length. These are different resources.
blocks.zh: 顾问LangGraph工具节点在第一次通过时执行12调预算. 专家最多4次呼叫无线电学家,1至3次呼叫安纳托米斯特,但所提供的专家节点没有执行同样的累积硬顶. Cononical RL包装器允许10个助手转弯和一个6,144个托肯续线;它的本地工具启动补丁额外应用了每回合的平行呼叫限制和检查续线长度. 这些是不同的资源。

blocks.en: During retrieval, assistant messages can contain brief intermediate reasoning. The final message is requested to contain five phases: selection/planning, evidence analysis, comparison or verification, insight synthesis, and answer. Consultant specifically uses multi-source review and doubt/verification as its middle phases. This structured final synthesis summarizes evidence acquired during interaction; it is not a fixed externally annotated sequence of retrieval actions.
blocks.zh: 在检索期间,助理消息可以包含简短的中间推理. 最后信息应包含五个阶段:选择/规划、证据分析、比较或核查、洞察力综合和回答。 顾问特别利用多来源审查和怀疑/核查作为其中间阶段。 这种结构化的最终综合总结了在互动过程中获得的证据;它不是一个固定的外部附加注释的检索动作序列.

blocks.en: The asynchronous engine begins in Pending , where it renders the prompt and tool schemas. Generating obtains one model response, marks its tokens as actions, and parses function calls. A parsed call enters ProcessingTools ; the engine executes at most the configured parallel-call allowance, serializes each returned observation, updates the accumulated images, and resumes Generating . Absence of a call, exhaustion of assistant turns, or the continuation limit enters Terminated . The generic Interacting state can append an external user response, but is not used by our evidence tools. The implementation adds JSON-parser fallback, Qwen3-VL multimodal-position handling, one placeholder per returned image, and empty-image handling for text-only microbatches. Scoring failure handling is detailed in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 同步引擎开始于“等待”,它使快速和工具计划。 生成获得一个模型响应,标记其符号为动作,并剖析函数调用. 解析调用输入处理工具 ; 引擎最多执行配置的并行调用量, 序列化每个返回的观察, 更新累积的图像, 并恢复生成 。 没有电话、助理轮班时间过长或续订期限进入终止期。 通用交互状态可以附加外部用户的响应,但是我们的证据工具没有使用. 执行中增加了JSON-parser倒置,Quen3-VL多式联运位置处理,每个返回的图像有一个占位符,以及仅用于文本微管的空图像处理. 分类故障处理详见附录H。

blocks.en: RL interaction is driven entirely by the project’s fork of the verl AgentLoop: the rendered system and user messages plus tool schemas are sent to vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) ; assistant text is parsed for XML-form tool calls; the six- or ten-tool mock registry is instantiated per participant and executed (several calls may run in one turn); returned text and images are serialized back as tool messages, re-encoded, and fed to the next generation step, with tool tokens masked out of the policy gradient and images re-passed through the vision encoder. The loop ends when the policy emits no further call or a cap is reached (6,144 continuation tokens, 10 assistant turns, 2,048 tokens per tool response); a batch then supplies eight trajectories per question to group-relative optimization. Evaluation reuses the same interface contract through a different implementation: an OpenAI-compatible vLLM server whose server-side parser extracts tool calls, wrapped in a two-node LangGraph loop over the real tool implementations (vista3d and medpanel read the segmentation and rendering directories; reports read the cache). The harnesses therefore differ in two confined ways (server-side versus in-loop call parsing and real versus mock tool execution) while sharing tool names, prompts, and caches, so recorded trajectories feed RL unchanged and evaluation inputs and outputs remain commensurate with training.
blocks.zh: RL 交互完全由 verl AgentLoop 的分叉驱动: 向 vLLLM (Kwon et al., 2023) 发送已提供系统和用户消息加工具计划; 为 XML 形式的工具调用解析助理文本; 六或十个工具的模拟注册被每个参与者即时跳过并执行( 几个调用可以一次运行); 返回的文本和图像被串回为工具信息, 重新编码, 并输入到下一代步骤, 工具符号被遮蔽在政策梯度中, 图像通过视觉编码器重传. 当政策没有发出进一步调用或达到上限(6,144个续约符,10个助手转动,每个工具响应2,048个令符)时,循环结束;然后批次为每题提供8个轨迹,用于组合相对优化. 评价通过不同的执行来重复使用相同的接口合同:一个OpenAI兼容的vLLM服务器,其服务器侧剖析器提取工具调用,包裹在真实工具执行的双节点LangGraph环上(vista3d和medpanel读取分区和渲染目录;报告读取缓存). 因此,在共享工具名称、提示和缓存的同时,这些工具在两种封闭方式上有所不同(服务器边和在机内调用、真实工具执行和模拟工具执行),因此记录的轨迹输入RL不变,评价投入和产出仍然与培训相称。

blocks.en: Figure 5 summarizes which parts of a rollout carry gradient. Gray context tokens (system prompt and question) are fixed and never trained; blue model-generated tokens (tool choice, arguments, the reasoning phases, and the final synthesis) are the only spans RL optimizes; orange tool-returned text enters the context as evidence only; and pink image placeholders mark returned images, which the vision encoder re-embeds at each generation step.
blocks.zh: 图5汇总了推出项目中哪些部分采用梯度。 灰色上下文符号(系统即时和问号)是固定的,从未受过训练;蓝色模型生成的符号(工具选择,参数,推理阶段,以及最终合成)是唯一的跨度RL优化;橙色工具返回文本作为证据仅进入上下文;粉红色图像占位符标记返回的图像,视觉编码器在每个代步骤中重新嵌入.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Token composition of a generic trajectory. Gray, fixed context (system prompt and question); blue, model-generated tokens, the only spans RL trains (tool choice, arguments, reasoning, synthesis); orange, tool-returned text (evidence, input only); pink, image placeholders for returned images, re-passed through the vision encoder.
blocks.zh: 图5:通用轨迹的托肯构成。 灰色,固定上下文(系统即时和提问);蓝色,模型生成的符号,唯一的跨度为RL列车(工具选择,参数,推理,合成);橙色,工具返回文本(证据,仅输入);粉红色,返回图像的图像占位符,通过视觉编码器重传.

blocks.zh: 附录C 培训 配置和数据物质化

blocks.en: Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) is invoked through the role-specific LangGraph recorder with the question, patient narrative, options, tool schema, and participant identifier, but without the reference answer. Each assistant tool request is executed before the next model call; textual results and base64-encoded images enter the running context, while saved JSONL records replace image payloads with resolvable paths. The raw record preserves the system/user messages, every assistant tool call, tool responses, image references, and the terminal synthesis. A dense companion record stores parsed phases, predicted and reference answers, correctness, tool-image metadata, and errors. The pre-selection inventory contains 46,632 Anatomist, 50,401 Radiologist, and 50,401 Consultant episodes, for 147,434 recordings in total. Training membership is determined by participant exclusion, trajectory availability, and the screening rule in eq. 3 ; raw recording counts are not retained-training counts. For Consultant, any ground-truth verdict, post-answer review reflection, and skill-writing calls are appended only after the first-pass answer and are not part of the answer-blind acquisition path.
blocks.zh: Qune3.8-Max(Quen Team,2026c)通过角色特异性的朗格拉夫记录器被引用,其中包含问题,耐心叙事,选项,工具计划,以及参与者识别符,但没有参考答案. 每个助手工具请求在下一个模型调用前执行;文本结果和基础64编码图像进入运行上下文,同时保存JSONL记录以可解析路径替换图像有效载荷. 原始记录保存系统/用户消息,每个助手工具呼叫,工具响应,图像参考,以及终端合成. 密集的伴奏记录存储解析阶段,预测和参考答案,正确性,工具图像元数据,以及错误. 预选盘中包含46,632位安纳托米主义者,50,401位放射学家,以及50,401集顾问,共计147,434集录音. 培训成员由参与者排除、轨迹可用性以及第3项中的筛选规则决定;原始记录计数不是保留培训计数。 对于顾问来说,任何地面真相判断、答题后回顾和技能写作的电话只有在先行回答后才附上,不属于解答盲获取路径的一部分。

blocks.en: The three agents answer the same diagnosis-derived questions and differ only in trajectory and tool registry, so the inventory above holds one episode per question for the Radiologist and Consultant and fewer for the Anatomist. A participant-disjoint manifest bucket, keyed by an MD5 hash of the participant identifier, reserves the held-out test split ( ρ = 0.1 \rho{=}0.1 ) and assigns the remaining episodes to RSFT and agentic RL, a 40 / 50 / 10 40/50/10 split in which 40 % 40\% of episodes train RSFT, 50 % 50\% form the agentic-RL pool from which 4 4 – 6 6 questions per participant are sampled as RL prompts, and the final 10 % 10\% is held out for testing. The test set is thus 4,850 4{,}850 questions from 455 455 participants; answering it under all three agents yields 14,135 14{,}135 agent–question evaluations, with the Radiologist and Consultant each covering all 4,850 4{,}850 questions ( 455 455 participants) and the Anatomist 4,435 4{,}435 questions ( 418 418 participants). The Anatomist shortfall arises because the remaining participants lack whole-body MRI at one or both visits, so Vista3D cannot segment their Dixon sequence; this is the coverage asymmetry shown in panels 1 and 5 of fig. 1 . RSFT and agentic RL together consume roughly 2,000 2{,}000 H100-80GB GPU-hours on a single 8 × 8\times H100 node.
blocks.zh: 这三个特工回答相同的诊断派问题,只在轨迹和工具登记上有所不同,因此上面的盘点为放射学家和顾问每个问题保留一集,而安纳托米主义者则较少. 由参与者身份识别符的MD5散列键入的参与者-不关联的列表桶,保留了搁置的测试拆分( ^ = 0.1\rho{=}0.1) , 并将其余的插座分配给RSFT和代理RL, 40 / 50 / 10 40/50 / 10 拆分, 其中40% 40 的列车RSFT, 50% / 50% 组成代理-RL集合, 其中4 4 – 6 位参与者作为 RL 提示进行抽样, 最后10% 10 + 被扣做测试。 因此,测试组为455 455名参与者的4 850 4{,}850个问题;在所有3名参与者的回答下,14 135 14{,}135个代理人 - 问题评价,放射学家和顾问各负责4 850 4{,}850个问题(455 455名参与者)和安纳托米主义者4 435 4{,}435个问题(418 418名参与者)。 安纳托米主义的不足之所以出现,是因为剩下的参与者在一次或两次访问时都缺乏全身核磁共振,因此Vista3D无法分割他们的狄克逊序列;这就是无花果的1和5面板所显示的覆盖不对称. 1,RSFT和代理RL共消耗约2,000 2{,}000 H100-80GB GPU小时在一个单 8×8\times H100节点上.

blocks.en: The rejection-sampling recipe scans existing records once. It requires at least one assistant tool call and a parseable Phase 4 insight in the final first-pass response. Kimi K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026a ) scores the written chain from evidence through insight to the Phase-5 answer on the fixed four-criterion rubric of table 12 , which weights evidence identification (0.3), logical reasoning (0.3), answer support (0.2), and completeness (0.2), and retains trajectories whose aggregate score is at least 0.4. It produces a retained participant/question manifest; it does not regenerate rejected trajectories or impose an independent answer-correctness condition. These requirements select complete trajectories and do not define an SFT token mask. The supplied training code consumes such manifests, but the complete filter script, accepted manifests, and raw responses are not included in this snapshot. Candidate, retained, failure-fallback, and per-role counts therefore remain required run artifacts rather than quantities inferred from cache sizes.
blocks.zh: 拒绝抽样的食谱扫描过已有的记录一次. 它需要至少一个助理工具呼叫和在最后的首发反应中解析第四阶段。 Kimi K2.6(Moonshot AI,2026a)通过洞察力对从证据到表12的固定四标面上的第五阶段答案的书面链进行评分,该表对证据识别(0.3),逻辑推理(0.3),回答支持(0.2)和完整性(0.2)进行评分,保留其总分至少为0.4的轨迹. 它生成一个保留的参与者/问题表;它不会重现被拒绝的轨迹,也不会强加一个独立的回答正确性条件。 这些要求选择了完整的轨迹,没有定义SFT标志面具. 所提供的训练代码会消耗这样的运算表,但完整的过滤脚本,接受的运算表,原始回复不包含在这个快照中. 因此,候选人、保留者、失败者倒计时和每个角色的计数仍需要运行文物,而不是从缓存大小推断出的数量。

blocks.en: The provided chain initializes a mixed-role SFT continuation from checkpoint 1515, fits one additional epoch using the extension manifests, and launches agentic RL from the final continuation model. If the final save is unavailable, the wrapper can select the latest intermediate checkpoint; this fallback must be recorded as a different initialization. All three configurations are mixed within training. The supplied chain does not train three separate policies in sequence.
blocks.zh: 所提供的链条从1515号检查站初始化了混合作用的SFT续作,适合使用延期清单的另外一个时代,并且从最后续作模型中推出代理RL。 如果最终保存不可用,包装器可以选择最新的中间检查点;这种倒置必须记录为不同的初始化. 这三个组合都混合在培训中。 供应的链条不按顺序培训三个独立的政策。

blocks.zh: 表9:RSFT和代理RL发射装置默认. 具体运行的超标和初始化检查站分别记录.

The weights 𝜽 t \bm{\theta}_{t} produced by the previous step are the step’s only active policy. vLLM samples rollouts from 𝜽 t \bm{\theta}_{t} ; the two OPSD scoring forwards (ordinary and answer-privileged) run on the same 𝜽 t \bm{\theta}_{t} ; the optimizer computes 𝜽 t + 1 \bm{\theta}_{t+1} from the collected batch and syncs it back to vLLM for the next step. blocks.en: SFT materializes recorded image references and uses assistant spans as prediction targets. Tool observations and system/user text provide context; padding is masked. Neither stage uses parameter-efficient adapters or freezes the ViT in the full-model setting. The SFT loader constructs the complete vision–language model, and the RL optimizer receives all actor parameters; the framework’s freeze_vision_tower flag, which would otherwise freeze the visual encoder (the ViT “vision tower”), stays at its default False . Observation masking removes local prediction losses but preserves the gradient path from later assistant tokens to visual features. All variants in fig. 3 retain full-parameter optimization.

blocks.en: The current mixed serializer chooses either the three-tool Anatomist or the three-tool Radiologist schema from observed calls; it has no explicit ten-tool Consultant branch. Loading three trajectory sources therefore does not establish identical schema conditioning across SFT and RL. The manifest interface admits explicit participant/question pairs; an acceptance manifest and a cached training sequence are distinct artifacts. Cache counts must not be reinterpreted as quality-screen retention counts.

blocks.en: After the participant-disjoint split, the RSFT stage retains 16,916 / 17,921 / 17,921 questions for the Anatomist, Radiologist, and Consultant roles. SFT renders each retained trajectory through the model chat template with images at their message positions and supervises assistant spans only (the tool-call segment and the terminal five-phase answer), masking system, user, and tool-returned tokens; span positions are recovered by incremental re-rendering and length differencing. Images are resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 and stored by path, then pretokenized by 64 parallel workers into per-sample tensors (inputs, labels, mask, image); this pass yields 48,464 samples trained for one epoch at learning rate 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} , producing the checkpoint that initializes RL. RL materializes one parquet row per training question (30,604 rows) carrying the data source, the rendered system and user messages, the reference answer, the agent name, and an extra-info bundle with the answer and options for scoring, the question text, the recorded teacher insight (used only as privilege, never shown to the policy), and a tool-parameter pack supplying each tool instance’s participant identifier. Rollout prompts contain no images: every view and measurement is acquired on-policy through tool calls. Mock tools then replay, deterministically and without GPU work, the cached result the real tool would have returned for that participant, tool, and argument set.

SFT通过模型聊天模板使每个保留轨迹的图像都位于其信息位置,监督助理只跨度(工具呼叫段和终端五相响应),遮蔽系统,用户和工具返回的代号;跨度位置通过递增的重新交接和长度的不同来恢复. 图像的大小调整为512×512 512\时,并按路径存储,然后由64名平行工人预置成每个样本的百分点(输入,标签,口罩,图像);此传得48,464个样本,按学习率3×10−6 3\时+6 ======================================================================================================================================================================================== RL实现每个培训问题(30,604行)一个parquet行,携带数据源、提供的系统和用户信息、参考答案、代理名称,以及一个附加信息包,其中包含解答和评分选项、问题文本、记录的教师见解(仅用作特权,从未向政策显示),以及一个工具参数包,提供每个工具实例的参与者标识。 推出提示不包含图像:每个视图和测量都是通过工具调用获取的。 模拟工具然后重新播放,确定性地和没有GPU的工作,缓存的结果是真正的工具会返回给那个参与者,工具和参数集.

blocks.en: Neither stage trains on ground-truth answers. RSFT distills recorded teacher trajectories whose terminal answers are the teacher’s own predictions (the reference is withheld during recording), so they act as pseudo-labels for action format and synthesis, not as ground truth. Agentic RL sees no ground-truth answer in context ; the reference enters only the outcome reward after the first-pass answer is locked, so the policy learns from reward signals alone . OPSD’s hint conditions only a detached scoring forward of a frozen snapshot through which gradients do not flow and which the updated policy never sees, so privileged scoring cannot leak the answer into acquisition behavior .
blocks.zh: 无论是舞台还是地面真实的答案 RSFT蒸馏器录制的教师轨迹,其终端答案是教师自己的预测(录音时不提及),因此它们充当动作格式和合成的伪标签,而不是作为地面真理. Agentic RL在上下文中没有看到地面真实的答案; 引用只输入第一个通过答案锁定后的结果奖励, OPSD的提示条件只是将一个冷冻的快照的前方分解出来, 通过这个快照, 梯度不会流动, 并且更新的政策从未看到,

blocks.en: We initialize from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct rather than a reasoning/thinking variant or a larger successor for three reasons. Training-start comparability: the Instruct variant avoids inheriting a checkpoint specialized for explicit chain-of-thought output. The Qwen3-VL technical report describes reinforcement-learning post-training for the model family, so this choice does not isolate CASE’s effects from all vendor-side RL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . Efficiency: at 8B parameters the full model (vision encoder, merger, decoder) plus optimizer state, rollouts, and the paired OPSD scoring forwards fit the single 8 × 80 8\times 80 GB node, whereas a larger backbone would force sharding or a separate scoring cluster. Stack stability: Qwen3.5 uses a gated-delta-network architecture ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) ; in our distributed rollout stack, its Triton/FlashInfer kernels compiled just in time at launch and intermittently deadlocked, whereas the Qwen3-VL kernel path compiled ahead of time and trained reliably.

blocks.en: Figure 7 extends the main-text zoom to the full epoch (steps 1–1,912) for the three RL variants, showing (a) the mean return and (b) the correctness reward. CASE-8B (full, teal) rises steadily with the smallest step-to-step variance and converges within the single epoch. GRPO+OPSD (red) does not collapse (the privileged brake suppresses the repetitive mode) but, lacking the rubric insight term, it is exposed to reward hacking: surface plausibility can be inflated without strengthening the evidence-to-answer logic, which is reflected in its lower endpoint accuracy. GRPO+RLAIF (blue) tracks the others early, then collapses in the highlighted band exactly where repetitive restatement overtakes commitment. The severity of this late degeneration also reflects the benchmark’s difficulty: each episode is a long horizon in which the policy itself chooses which studies, modality, sequence, and frame to inspect, so an unresolved evidence path leaves no reliable basis on which to conclude, and restatement is the cheapest continuation.

GRPO+RLAIF(蓝色)早期跟踪其他的,然后在突出显示的波段中完全在重复重述超过承诺的地方崩溃. 这种晚期退化的严重程度也反映了基准的难度:每集都是一个很长的视野,其中政策本身选择了哪些研究、模式、序列和框架来检查,因此一个尚未解决的证据路径没有可靠的依据可以得出结论,重述是最便宜的延续。

blocks.en: Appendix D Positioning within On-Policy Distillation and Agentic RL
blocks.zh: 附录D 在政策消化和代理RL中的位置

blocks.en: On-policy sampling, the source of teacher information, and the way feedback enters optimization are separate design choices. Student-generated rollouts do not themselves imply self-distillation: GKD, RLAD, TGPO, and OPDVR use external teachers in their studied formulations. For privileged self-distillation, shared weights do not make all update rules equivalent. Table 11 separates direct student supervision, local advantage modulation, and trajectory-level reward construction.
blocks.zh: 政策抽样,师资信息来源,反馈进入优化的方式是独立的设计选择. 学生产生的推广本身并不意味着自我消化:GKD、RLAD、TGPO和OPDVR在学习配方中使用外部教师。 对于特权的自我消化,共享权重并不能使所有更新规则等同. 表11将学生直接监管,地方优势调制,轨迹级奖励建设分开.

blocks.en: TRACE selects annotated critical or error spans and supplies coarse diagnostic labels to its teacher; the locations gate its loss rather than being copied into the privileged prompt. Our insight region instead follows a structured response phase with an approximate implementation mask ( Section 5.4 ). We neither identify causally decisive tokens nor directly differentiate an insight distillation loss. The comparison is between a routed process loss and a trajectory-ranking signal, not between selective and indiscriminate distillation.
blocks.zh: TRACE选择附加注释的临界值或误差跨度,并向它的老师提供粗糙的诊断标签;地点会挡住它的损失,而不是被复制到特权提示中. 我们的洞察力区域则沿着一个结构化的反应阶段走,并带有大致的执行面具(第5.4节)。 我们既未发现具有因果关系的迹象,也未直接区分洞察力蒸馏损失。 比较是在路由过程损失和轨迹级信号之间,而不是选择性蒸馏和不加区分的蒸馏之间。

blocks.en: Yang et al. (2026) and Wu et al. (2026) preserve the sign of the inherited trajectory advantage in OCSD and SSPO while changing selected token or step weights. In our formulation, R n , j = sg ⁡ [ B j − λ CKL ​ D n , j CKL ] R_{n,j}=\sg[B_{j}-\lambda_{\mathrm{CKL}}D^{\mathrm{CKL}}_{n,j}] is formed before group normalization ( Equation 7 ), so the synthesis penalty can change the ordering of whole trajectories and hence their relative-advantage signs. All assistant actions within a trajectory inherit that same scalar. This can train the acquisition policy, but does not isolate which preceding retrieval caused a good or poor synthesis. Tian et al. (2026) and Zhang et al. (2026b) provide further relevant controls through turn-level PBSD modulation and token-level ADRS shaping.

(2026)保留OSSD和SSPO中继承的轨迹优势的标志,同时改变选定的令牌或步重. 在我们的表述中,Rn,j = sg ⁡ [B j - λ CKL D n, j CKL] R_{n,j}=\sg [B_{j}]-\lambda_{\mathrm{CKL}}D^{\mathrm{CKL}}_{n,j}]在组团正常化(方程式7)前形成,因此合成惩罚可以改变整个轨迹的顺序,从而改变它们的相对优势标志. 在轨迹内的所有助理动作都继承了同样的标尺. 这可以培训获取政策,但不会孤立在检索之前导致合成好坏的哪一种。 Tian等人(2026年)和Zhang等人(2026年b)通过转动级的PBSD调制和符号级的ADRS塑造提供了进一步的关联控制.

blocks.en: Training-only privilege is intended to reduce unresolved synthesis and redundant restatement, not to reward short responses as such. A lower distributional penalty need not imply less repetition or a correct inference: a model could also ignore the privilege or rationalize a known answer. Controlled comparisons should therefore report repetition and loop frequency together with accuracy, evidence sensitivity, and token use. A full-system accuracy gain does not establish an OPSD-specific effect.
blocks.zh: 仅培训的特权意在减少未解决的合成和多余的重述,而不是奖励短的答复本身. 较低的分配处罚不一定意味着较少重复或正确的推论:模型也可以忽略特权或使已知答案合理化。 因此,控制下的比较应报告重复和循环频率以及准确性、证据敏感性和象征性使用。 全系统的精度增益并不能确定OPSD的特定效果.

blocks.en: Appendix E Rubric-Based Feedback and Group-Relative Selection
blocks.zh: 附录E 以Rubric为基础的反馈和分组选择

blocks.en: RL uses batch rubric scoring as task-specific direct AI feedback ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , followed by within-group top-2 selection. Each scoring item contains the question, options, reference answer, predicted answer, and Phase-4 insight; images and the full tool log are excluded. The prompt truncates question and option text to 300 characters each and insight text to 800. The configured judge, kimi-k2.6 , returns one aggregate score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and a brief justification. The four criteria in table 12 define its allocation, not separately measured subscores.
blocks.zh: RL使用批量路标评分作为任务特定的直接AI反馈(Lee et al., 2024),然后进行组内顶级-2选择. 每个评分项目包含问题,选项,参考答案,预测答案,以及第四阶段的洞察力;图像和完整的工具日志被排除在外. 快速将问题和选项文本切换到每个字符300个,洞察文本切换到800个。 已配置的法官kimi-k2.6在 [0, 1] [0, 1] 中返回一个总分,并有一个简短的理由. 表12中的四项标准界定了其分配,而不是单独计量的分数。

blocks.en: The rubric term is supplied by an external judge API and is therefore a black-box feedback signal; a natural concern is that observed gains merely track one scorer’s idiosyncrasies, as discussed for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Figure 8 re-runs the training-time diagnostics under three judge models (Kimi K2.6 ( Moonshot AI, 2026a ) , blue solid; Qwen3.7-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , red dashed; DeepSeek V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) , teal dashed). In (a) the causal-KL between ordinary and answer-privileged synthesis decreases steadily over steps 0–1,912 (1 epoch) for every judge, indicating that synthesis becomes progressively less dependent on the privileged hint (the policy resolves the answer from its own gathered evidence), independently of which scorer ranks the insights. In (b) the judged insight score rises throughout training for all three judges even though their absolute levels differ, reflecting genuine differences in scoring strictness and openness rather than divergent trends. Together these show a consistent upward trend across the three tested judges; agreement among model-based scorers does not by itself establish independently verified clinical grounding.
blocks.zh: 标点词是由外部法官API提供的,因此是一个黑盒反馈信号;一个自然的担忧是,观测到的收益仅仅是跟踪一个评分员的特异性,正如LLM-as-a-judge评价(郑等人,2023年)所讨论的那样。 图8以三种裁判模型(Kimi K2.6(Moonshot AI,2026a),蓝色固体;Qune3.7-Plus(Quen Team,2026b),红色破损;DeepSeek V4-Flash(DeepSeek-AI等人,2026年),teal破损)重新进行训练时间诊断. 在(a)中,普通合成和答题合成之间的因果-KL在每名法官的0-1 912(1个时代)步骤中稳步下降,表明综合逐渐减少对特权暗示的依赖(政策从自己收集的证据中解决答案),而分数者则将洞察力排在其中。 在(b)中,对所有三名法官进行培训时,经过判断的洞察力得分会提高,尽管他们的绝对水平不同,这反映了在评分严格性和开放性方面的真正差异,而不是不同的趋势。 这三个受试法官的成绩一致上升;基于模型的得分者之间的协议本身并不能建立独立核实的临床基础。

blocks.en: A versioned role-specific manifest fixes participant/question identifiers, task–format strata, options, labels, and evidence availability before inference. All methods within a panel share prompts, tools, stopping rules, and parsing. The supplied evaluator uses temperature zero, 6,144 tokens per response, and a 16,384-token local context limit; the Anatomist permits 4 executed tool calls, the Radiologist 6, and the Consultant 12. Resolved model/API versions, inference-effort settings, image limits, and denominators accompany each result. Matched interfaces do not imply identical provider-side compute.

blocks.en: The complementary insight score is produced by a single judge whose API version and prompt are pinned and reported, so scores stay comparable over time even as provider models are updated. This judge is held out from the RL reward model, so the policy is never trained toward the evaluator, and all methods in a panel are scored in one batch under the same rubric, temperature, and option ordering. To confirm that conclusions do not hinge on one judge, we re-score a subset with at least one additional judge from a different provider and report rank correlation and any order changes.

blocks.en: Canonicalization ignores option order and duplicates but rejects out-of-set letters and multiple selections on single-select items. Multi-select requires complete set equality. Missing records, terminal failures, and invalid answers score zero; recoverable tool errors alone do not invalidate a final answer. Archived extractors recognize A–I and may default to A after failure, so final scoring must reparse the original response against the actual option set, including J where applicable.

The interaction contrast A 11 − A 10 − A 01 + A 00 = ( A 11 − A 01 ) − ( A 10 − A 00 ) A_{11}-A_{10}-A_{01}+A_{00}=(A_{11}-A_{01})-(A_{10}-A_{00}) compares the accuracy gain from rubric feedback when OPSD is already present against the gain when OPSD is absent. It vanishes if the two components contribute additively and is nonzero only when they interact, so it measures their synergy in accuracy units without presuming that their benefits simply add. blocks.en: Table 16 separates answer priors, supplied context, and autonomous acquisition. Question-only retains the question and options but no patient evidence. A fixed packet is selected by a prespecified rule without test labels or model-specific retrieval and respects the same context ceiling. Adaptive acquisition uses the full environment. Removing a source also removes its derivatives: the earlier-visit-only condition, for example, excludes follow-up findings from reports, measurements, and narratives as well as images. blocks.en: Causal-KL is the mean of eq. 6 over successfully scored trajectories with valid insight spans. Each checkpoint supplies both distributions, so this diagnostic has no fixed external reference and is not a cross-model clinical-quality metric. A decrease can also reflect reduced sensitivity to the hint rather than improved reasoning. Scoring failures and missing spans are reported as coverage, never recoded as zero divergence. Hold the span rule, scoring temperature, and privilege fields fixed, and add privilege only for offline scoring after the first-pass answer is locked. In addition to policy-generated histories, score a fixed held-out history bank with identical tokens, images, and privileges across checkpoints to separate changes in scoring behavior from changes in acquired evidence. Swapping RSFT- and RL-collected evidence prefixes before generating a fresh synthesis further distinguishes acquisition quality from synthesis quality. These analyses do not replace end-to-end accuracy.

blocks.en: The archived Consultant pilot reports 3,752 correct answers among 4,850 questions (77.36%). Of 220 detected extraction failures, 49 were counted correct through fallback to option A. Treating all detected failures as incorrect yields 3703 / 4850 = 76.35 % 3703/4850=76.35\% . These are alternative scoring conventions for the same predictions. The pilot reports initially cold skill memory, no first-pass retrieval matches, and no reuse of newly written skills. A model that ignores the privilege can satisfy q = p q=p while producing an incorrect or unsupported explanation; bucket equality additionally allows unequal full distributions within the tail. Answer correctness and rubric feedback supply complementary signals, but their combination does not eliminate all such failures or certify image grounding. Refreshing both conditional distributions with 𝜽 ¯ n \bar{\bm{\theta}}_{n} makes the self-teacher evolve with the policy.
